result.title: What Matters for LLM Persona Simulation: Signal Form in Cold-Start E-Commerce Advertising
result.comment: Accepted at GenAIECommerce'26: The Third Workshop on Agentic and Generative AI for E-Commerce, co-located with RecSys 2026. 13 pages
result.summary: Estimating advertising performance in cold-start settings is challenging because historical logs are unavailable before launch. Large language models (LLMs) offer a potential alternative by simulating persona-conditioned user responses, but it remains unclear which design choices actually drive LLM-based persona simulation. Using real Google Ads e-commerce campaign data across five demographic segments, we identify three signal-form dimensions that affect simulation quality: (i) a demographic anchor without noisy rich attributes, (ii) a relative qualitative banner-blindness signal rather than quantitative anchors, and (iii) prompt phrasing. On this campaign, our method attains an MAE of 24.9 and a MAPE of 26.1%, a 51.3% lower MAE than the best tested non-LLM baseline and 77.3% lower than an LLM configuration using explicit CTR anchors. Systematic ablations show that minimal demographic descriptions achieve lower mean error than richer persona configurations, while relative qualitative cues substantially outperform the tested quantitative anchors. We additionally compare these configurations with direct-prior and rule-based baselines and with alternative LLM configurations.

AI.brief_summary: 该文用真实 Google Ads 冷启动电商广告数据检验 LLM 人格化模拟中哪些设计选择影响效果，发现极简人口统计锚点、相对的定性信号以及提示措辞是三项关键因素，并用消融与基线比较给出误差改善。其中“更丰富的人格属性反而误差更高、相对定性线索优于定量锚点”这一观察，与 LVR 中多模态条件信号的粒度、相对与绝对形式如何影响模型推理，可能存在形式上的可比性，可供核查其是否在视觉属性或几何线索注入时复现。
AI.relevance_reason: 领域较远，存在具体借鉴线索，即“属性越丰富未必越好”的信号形式消融，或可启发对 LVR 条件信号粒度问题的假设。
